variants.suspected_cause: The two redraw F_h00_8A46 calls use background rectangle constants instead of the target redraw rectangle constants and omit the two 0x14 coordinates.
variants.controlled_change: Change only the argument tuples of the frame redraw and post-loop redraw F_h00_8A46 calls to the disassembled target tuple.

predicted_effect.note: Each call changes two CLR.L pushes into four-byte PEA immediate pushes, adding four bytes per call; the initial background draw remains unchanged.
